title: CHOIR: Collaborative Harmonization fOr Inference Robustness
findings: Assigning personas with different religious identities (Jewish, Christian, atheist) to language models leads to performance variations on reasoning tasks. The proposed CHOIR framework mitigates these variations and consistently improves reasoning accuracy and robustness across the Religion demographic group, similar to other demographic groups tested.
